verdict: netns blackout + unix-socket proxy bridge HOLDS — hard egress boundary without xt_owner

checks.name: bare netns is a total network blackout
proxy allows allowlisted host and refuses others
checks.expect: code=200 for api.github.com, non-200 for example.com

checks.name: jailed mcp reaches the ALLOWLISTED host through the bridge
jailed mcp is REFUSED for a non-allowlisted host
raw socket to a hardcoded IP is blocked (ignoring HTTP_PROXY does not help)
checks.expect: every destination blocked — no route exists
checks.got:
blocked 140.82.121.6 OSError
blocked 1.1.1.1 OSError
blocked 8.8.8.8 OSError

checks.name: DNS from the jail is blocked (kills DNS-tunnel exfil)
checks.got: socket.gaierror: [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution

checks.name: jailed mcp cannot setns back to the host namespace
checks.got:
nsenter: cannot open /proc/1/ns/net: Permission denied
 exit=1
